title: Canonical Target-Date T−24 Snapshot Builder
mission: Build deterministic, replayable source snapshots for each target date containing only information eligible at the cutoff.
steps: For each target date calculate cutoff UTC.
Select latest eligible official vintage and retain revision history IDs.
Select latest eligible run per model and all required target-day valid hours; retain earlier eligible runs for aging/revision.
Attach causally available target-memory source dates.
Hash selected source IDs/objects and builder version.
Create development snapshots without joining labels; labels join only in research role.
acceptance: No forward-looking row can enter feature generation
failure: Missing source yields explicit availability mask, not future fallback
